style: Use case: stylized-concept. Individual transparent PNG game icon, square canvas, isolated centered subject fills 80% with even padding, readable at 48px. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match the existing Cat-Cook Japanese picture-book illustrations: flat gouache and colored-pencil grain within objects, thick soft wobbly dark-brown #2b211b outline, chunky rounded silhouette, muted warm cream #fff8ec, red #d7263d, gold #f5b82e, green #3fa66b, simple flat base + one shadow shape + cream highlight, slight three-quarter top-down view. Genuine transparent background. No text, letters, numbers, brand logos, food faces, background, tile, cast shadow, gradients, gloss, 3D or emoji style. Ceramic dishes may use the same small cream blossom decoration as the reference.

assets.subject: A small red-and-cream ceramic dish of several green edamame pods, one open pod showing three beans.

Japanese agedashi tofu: three lightly fried tofu cubes with white interiors in a shallow cream ceramic bowl with amber dashi sauce, scallions and ginger.
